floor_history.headline: First honest pure-C measurement of motion_Close (floor 21->20, structure an exact match) — and a corpus-wide kill: gcc-2.7.2 o32 reserves REG_PARM_STACK_SPACE=16 for every C-level call, so the target'

frontier.hypothesis: F1 — motion_Close's original source was hand-written assembly (PsyQ crt0 runtime), which is why its frame has no outgoing-arg area and its beqz delay slot is unfilled.
frontier.mechanism: Both anomalies are things GCC provably does not produce: the arg area is forced to >=16 by REG_PARM_STACK_SPACE for any C-level call (H1, measured 854/854), and reorg.c fills an available delay slot (the honest C form does fill it). Corroborated by the crt0 neighborhood and the ctor-table-walk body shape.
frontier.next_probe: Extract asm/funcs/motion_Close.s (currently absent — the function is C-routed), then run tools/scan_hand_coded.py --single motion_Close to obtain a signal tier. The endgame-lock canonical-asm gate requires STRONG signals (S1/S2/S6); this must be measured before any escalation packet cites it. Re-examine the canonical gate's C verdict, which was reached on 'distance 21 <= 50' i.e. on size alone.

frontier.hypothesis: F2 — the residual between the honest pure-C form and the target is EXACTLY the nine regfix rules at regfix.txt:115-124, with no unexplained instruction.
frontier.mechanism: If every mismatch classifies into (a) frame size, (b) the six save/restore offsets, (c) the s0/s1 roles + v0-vs-t0 temp, or (d) the one unfilled delay slot, then the gap is fully characterized and the function is a clean 'bytes-provable only through a surface the grinder may not touch' case rather than an open grind.
frontier.next_probe: Write a differ pairing the 26 target insns against the 25 build insns, classify each mismatch into those four buckets, and assert the buckets are exhaustive. Turns the escalation packet from narrative into a table. Cheap — the two dumps already exist in tmp/grind/motion_Close/s1/dump.py.

frontier.hypothesis: F3 (LOW VALUE, only after F1/F2) — the s0/s1 role split and the v0-vs-t0 scalar temp are movable by a natural C spelling.
frontier.mechanism: p and count have near-identical reference counts and identical live ranges, so local-alloc/global-alloc priority tie-breaks decide. A lever would have to change reference counts or live ranges naturally (the *p++ idiom, a plain while rather than if+do-while, hoisting the guard load).
frontier.next_probe: Measure the *p++ idiom and the while-loop spelling. NOTE: under H1 this axis cannot produce a match on its own — its only value is making the 'everything except the frame closes' claim airtight. If F1 returns a STRONG hand-asm tier, F3 is moot entirely. Do not open it first.
